'''2015 European Championship Day 2 Robert Smolarek LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Robert Smolarek]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Robert Smolarek]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V)|Endor-L-carefulplanning.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness (V) Smolarek LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Username:''' Babba the Hutt
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125919/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
